_note: One line per detail, in the order the tour reaches it. gap = seconds of silence before the line (time to scroll or change page). ids are used by record_tour.js. Keep 'phone' and 'close' as the last two lines.

lines.say: This is the new website for Eleven Restaurant and Lounge, in Savanna la Mar. It opens like a movie, with a few seconds of their own footage.
Behind the headline, three panels of real footage keep playing. And for anyone who prefers less movement, there's a pause button.
Every Order now button opens one simple menu. Guests can call, message on Instagram, send an email, or get directions.
As you scroll, the menu bar turns solid, and it always shows which part of the page you're on.
The welcome section uses their own photos, with the Eleven name traced softly behind them.
This ribbon of highlights keeps gliding across the page, and it pauses the moment you hover over it.
Signature dishes come alive as you hover: the photo zooms in, and a short description slides up.
The lobster gets a bold price card of its own.
This photo band drifts with a gentle parallax as you scroll past.
The whole menu is searchable. Type shrimp, and it filters instantly, with a live count of what matched.
Or tap a category, like drinks.
Search for something they don't serve, and a friendly message offers the full menu back in one tap.
Prices sit on dotted leaders, just like a printed menu, and guest favourites are tagged.
Pick your vibe sets the mood: the food, the lounge, or the crew. Each tab brings its own photo and colour.
What's on shows Cabaret Live every Thursday, and what's coming next.
In the gallery, captions slide up as you hover, and the video tiles preview silently.
Open one, and it plays full screen, with a counter and arrows to step through the photos.
Hours, directions, and a live open now badge. It checks the time in Jamaica, and today's hours are highlighted.
Even the footer has a story: its line comes from the neon sign inside Eleven. You are exactly where you need to be.
Events get their own page, from Cabaret Live to past show nights, like their fire and aerial show.
The contact page puts every way to reach them in one place, and the message form checks itself before sending.
And on a phone, the menu slides in from the side, and a call button follows you down the page.
Fast, mobile friendly, and built to bring people through the door. Website by Steven Scale Solutions.
